The `BancorExchangeProvider` applies an ""exit contribution"" fee when a user sells the supply token. If a user sells the entire remaining supply of the token, the contract calculates the full reserve amount to be returned and then subtracts the exit contribution. Since the supply becomes zero, the remaining contribution fee cannot be redeemed by anyone and becomes permanently stuck in the contract. This results in a loss of funds and violates the principle of fund recoverability.
